title: PSGBlocker
description: PSG Blocker keeps your chat clean with powerful word filtering, anti-spam, and fully customizable join/leave messages for a professional server feel.
body:
PSG Blocker is a lightweight, high-performance plugin designed to give server administrators complete authority over their chat environment and player notifications. Instead of relying on pre-made lists, it puts the power in your hands to define exactly what belongs on your server.

✨ Key Features
📝 100% Custom Filtering: The message.yml comes clean by default—no pre-set words or hidden filters. You have total control to add exactly the words, phrases, or slurs you want to block.

🚫 Smart Chat Blocking: Automatically stop or censor messages containing your custom-defined blocked words.

👋 Professional Join & Leave Messages: Create a unique first impression with fully customizable join and leave notifications.

⚡ Anti-Spam Protection: Keep your chat readable and prevent players from flooding the console with repetitive messages.

⚙️ Optimized for Performance: Designed to run efficiently on any setup, ensuring your server stays lag-free even during high-traffic moments.

🚀 How It Works
Install the plugin and restart your server.

Open the message.yml file in your plugin folder.

Add your custom list of blocked words and set your unique join/leave messages.

Save and reload—your server is now protected exactly how you want it!
